content: As a 30 year loyal customer of your fine cigarettes, I am appalled at this hypocritical NON-SENSE the government is giving your industry.
Teenage drinking is far more deadly then teenage smoking so why aren’t these anti-smokers chasing beer companies?
I am currently a DORAL smoker but recently I tried your test-market no additive Winston brand and my opinion has me confused.
You’ve been accused of adding deadly additives to cigarettes when in fact, if Winston is pure tobacco, the additives in other brands are a waste.
Without question Winston No Additives are by far the best tasting cigarette I’ve ever smoked.
Financially I can’t afford them regularly so I must stay with Doral.
It is my fervent hope that whatever happens in your settlement you folks
